summary: A page's content stream is not in the file, so the page shows blank.
A link goes to a page or named destination the file does not have.
The page tree's /Count disagrees with the pages it holds.
A page's content stream cannot be decoded, so part of the page may not draw.
A font's program is not in the file, so viewers without it draw its text with another font (info for the standard 14).
An annotation lies outside its page's media box, where no viewer shows it.
A form field marked required has no value.
A list or combo box field's value is not one of its options.
A text field's value is longer than its maximum length.
An action or stream names another file (a program to launch, another PDF, form data to import, stream data kept elsewhere); Kition PDF never opens, runs or reads it.
A tagged figure has no alternative text for screen readers.
The file is encrypted and its permissions deny printing, editing, copying or other actions.
A code was found more than 100 times; the rest are counted, not listed.
